subject: expression: fix tikv crash when `bool like cast(bit as char)` (#57484)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent: it special-cases `CAST(... AS CHAR)` for `BIT` to first cast `BIT` to a binary string, then rely on existing `HandleBinaryLiteral` / `from_binary` path to validate/convert to the target charset (preventing TiKV crash on invalid byte sequences). Also fixes `builtinInternalFromBinarySig.Clone()` to preserve `cannotConvertStringAsWarning`, avoiding behavior changes when expressions are cloned. Planner-side changes are test expectation updates only; no new Blocker/High correctness or semantics issues found in the changed production logic.
